decision: keep key, duree_moyenne, arrival counts, retard_moyen_arrivee, sup_15/30/60
why: departure, causes and comments don't serve our question; retard_moyen_tous_trains mixes frequency and magnitude
an identical row adds no information

issue: same route-month published as National AND International (2025-07 to 09 only)
why: these 14 routes are National every other month; keeping both counts the route twice
no pair of names above 0.8 similarity among 58 stations

issue: impossible values (negative, more cancellations than planned, more late than run...)
impossible values: sup_30 negative or 0, sup_60 > sup_30 (355 rows, all in 2025-01 to 2025-03)
decision: set the 3 tiers to NaN for the whole quarter, keep the rows
why: systematic publication error on one quarter, not random; main columns are valid so rows are kept

issue: could the T1 2025 publication error affect other columns?
why: monthly late rate, weighted mean delay and duration of T1 2025 are in the range of neighbouring months and of T1 2024 / T1 2026; no jump

decision: leave as NaN, no imputation; tiers analysed on other months only
why: MAR: missingness depends only on date (100% in 2025-01 to 03, 0% elsewhere)

issue: Barcelona-Paris route switches from International to National in 2025-10
decision: keep as is; analyse this route without splitting by service
why: not missing data: same route relabelled, all 69 months are present
no train ran outside that period, nothing to measure

issue: Tourcoing->Marseille published 1 month out of 69 (reverse Marseille->Tourcoing: 68 months)
decision: keep as is, do not assume every route has a return
why: structural: some routes are only published one way, return trains run on another branch and are counted under another route (domain knowledge)

issue: high outliers > 90 min (IQR on log scale)
decision: keep; weight by nb_train_retard_arrivee in analysis
why: real incidents on long routes, often a mean over 1-2 late trains: extreme but not wrong
a mean delay of 0 is impossible when trains were late: 0 fills an empty value
logical: no late train, mean delay = 0
plausible on short routes: AQST counts a train late from 5 min if trip < 1h30
